title: Internal: clearing a demurrage invoice line issued too late
content:
## Scope

Under the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category, a demurrage invoice line of a per-container record that was issued after the invoicing deadline is not collectible. This entry covers when such a line is cleared and the internal tool that books the clearance.

## When it applies

1. A demurrage invoice line whose date is later than the record's clock-stop date plus the product's invoice issue deadline in days is not collectible, and it is cleared by a waiver recorded as a late invoice.
2. Before the line is cleared, the following must already hold:

> Any overcharge a late demurrage row carries against its recomputation is credited through a decided dispute before the row is cleared.

That is, the part of the line that exceeds its recomputation must already have been taken off by the credit of a decided dispute, so that the late-invoice waiver acts on what remains; until that holds, the late line is not cleared.

3. A late detention line is cleared under the general invoice dispute rules alone.

## Business effect of the booking

- One waiver entry dated today is written on the free-time record, recorded with the reason late invoice and pointing at the invoice line it clears.
- The balance the billed party owes on the record is lowered by the amount waived.
- The customer then sees the late-invoice waiver against that line and the lower balance.

## How it is invoked

The tool is **clear_late_invoice_2264ae48**. The agent must first unlock it (unlock, through unlock_agent_discoverable_tool) and then call it (call, through call_agent_discoverable_tool); it is an internal tool.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| dnd_id | Reference number of the free-time record carrying the invoice line, as returned by the free-time record lookup | identifier |
| customer_id | Customer reference number of the billed party, as returned by the customer profile lookup | identifier |
| reference_event_id | Invoice reference of the invoice line being cleared, as returned by the account entry lookup | identifier |
| amount_usd | Amount waived | USD, a positive figure given to 2 decimal places |

## Return

A successful booking answers "Late-invoice waiver (waiver reference) of USD (amount) booked against invoice line (invoice reference) on record (record reference); balance due now USD (balance)." The balance is the record's outstanding amount in USD to 2 decimal places after the waiver. An answer starting with "Error:" means no record exists under that reference and nothing was booked.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates; an illustrative deadline of 10 days)

| Clock-stop date | Demurrage line dated | Late? |
|---|---|---|
| 3 August | 13 August | no, not later than 3 August plus 10 days |
| 3 August | 14 August | yes, not collectible |
